name: topology-shell
title: Spacious Topology Shell
description: Complete Fumadocs Spacious-inspired network topology workspace shell in React/Next.js TSX framing compiled Marrow diagrams with collapsible sidebar, floating camera controls, 5-tab telemetry inspector, and Ctrl+K search.

name: topology-sidebar
title: Topology Sidebar
description: Spacious left navigation rail with zone switcher dropdown, Ctrl+K search trigger, gliding hover highlight block, collapsible device hierarchy, and canvas layer switches.

name: topology-canvas
title: Topology Stage
description: Clean workspace stage card that frames the main viewport with live hardware telemetry, dot grid, breadcrumbs, and floating camera controls HUD.

name: topology-inspector
title: Topology Inspector
description: Floating rounded-2xl right sibling card with 5 segmented tabs (Overview, Interfaces, Neighbors, Fields, Config) and copyable CLI configuration stanzas.

name: topology-controls
title: Topology Controls & Minimap
description: Floating vertical zoom/fit/command pill and interactive SVG minimap overlay.

name: topology-search
title: Topology Command & Search
description: Ctrl+K spotlight modal for searching devices, IPs, security zones, links, and canvas actions.
